remarks: Find your perfect city retreat in this stylish loft apartment, perfectly situated in the historic and lively Wall Street neighborhood. This beautifully updated space seamlessly blends modern design with historic charm. Imagine soaring 10+ foot ceilings, original exposed brick, and huge windows flooding the apartment with natural light, creating an open and airy feel. The gorgeous modern kitchen boasts stainless steel appliances - refrigerator, dishwasher, stove/oven, and microwave - paired with sleek cabinetry and elegant quartz countertops. A bright and open dining and living area with hardwood floors is next to the kitchen and has a private entrance to a large outdoor deck that offers ample privacy - perfect for entertaining or relaxing. You can also unwind in the modern, fully-tiled bathroom with a glass-enclosed luxury shower as well as enjoy the added convenience of an in-unit washer and dryer. The bedrooms offer abundant closet space and room for personalization and comfortable living. A high-efficiency HVAC system ensures year-round comfort. This home includes off-street parking for one car, with the option for additional vehicles. Located in a desirable central Norwalk location, you'll be steps away from parks, fantastic restaurants, and fashionable shopping, with easy access to highways and public transportation for a simplified commute.
